bash -lc cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/analytics-site.conf <<'EOF'
<VirtualHost *:9090>
    ServerName localhost
    DocumentRoot /var/www/content

    CustomLog /var/log/apache2/traffic-access.log "%t %m %s %{Referer}i [%a]"

    <Directory /var/www/content>
        Options Indexes FollowSymLinks
        AllowOverride None
        Require all granted
    </Directory>
</VirtualHost>

Listen 9090
EOF
